name: 78726 · Austin, TX
findings: ZIP 78726 (Austin) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78726 (Austin) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78726 (Austin) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
